meta.name: fallback-file-ops
meta.description: Use run_shell as fallback when execute_code_sandbox or shell_agent fail on filesystem operations

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用本地命令自动重试失败的文件操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果文件操作经常因沙箱限制而失败
copy.tagline_en: Automatically retry failed file operations with local shell
copy.fit_line_en: For you if file operations often fail due to sandbox restrictions

howto.what: 当使用代码沙箱或shell工具创建文件/目录失败时，Claude会自动改用run_shell命令直接执行，并验证操作是否成功。
howto.when: 当execute_code_sandbox或shell_agent返回'unknown error'，或文件操作无声失败（如目录未创建）时触发。

say.text: 创建一个多级目录结构，比如 src/components
写一个多行文本文件到当前目录
检查刚创建的文件是否存在

howto.what_en: When sandbox or shell agent fails on file/directory creation, Claude automatically falls back to run_shell with explicit commands and verifies success.
howto.when_en: Triggered when execute_code_sandbox or shell_agent returns 'unknown error' or silently fails on file operations (e.g., directory not created).

say_en.text: Create a nested directory structure like src/components
say_en.note: Claude tries sandbox first, falls back to run_shell mkdir -p.

say_en.text: Write a multi-line text file to current directory
say_en.note: Claude uses cat heredoc via run_shell.

say_en.text: Check if the just-created file exists
say_en.note: Claude uses test command via run_shell.
